query.en: Make a 15-second motion design showreel that proves you are a world-class motion designer. Pack in several distinct techniques — bold kinetic typography, a shape that morphs into something new, an animated interface moment and a quick data flourish — but keep one visual identity and one recurring motif that links every cut. Off-white canvas, ink-black type, a single vivid accent color. End on a confident signature card for the fictional studio "Studio Kinetik", held for two seconds.
query.zh-CN: 制作一段 15 秒的动效设计作品集快剪，展示你是一流的动效设计师。融入几种不同的手法：大字号动态排版、一个变形成新物体的图形、一段界面动效和一个简短的数据动画；但整体保持同一种视觉风格，并用一个反复出现的元素串起每一次切换。米白背景、墨黑文字，只用一种鲜明的强调色。结尾是一张自信的署名卡，署名为虚构工作室“Studio Kinetik”，停留两秒。
